github-actions[bot] opened issue #14790:

ZipStreamReader::extract() and ZipArchive::extract() apply Unix permissions through symlinks without confining the target

Details
Package zip
Version 0.6.6
Date 2026-10-10
Patched versions >=9.0.0

ZipStreamReader::extract() applies Unix permissions through extracted symlinks without validating the symlink target stays within the destination

For further details see: https://github.com/zip-rs/zip2/security/advisories/GHSA-4684-h2q9-2vcp

See advisory page for additional details.

alexcrichton commented on issue #14790:

This dependency is used through tch which is an optional dependency of wasmtime-wasi-nn. Although our version of tch is pretty far behind the latest published one, even updating that still keeps zip at today's dependency of 0.6.6. That means that as of this moment there's no way to update this dependency.

That being said it's only a dependency of wasmtime-wasi-nn, it's an optional dependency, and it's off-by-default. I don't know what it's using zip for, however. It's both a build and a runtime dependency, so I don't know the surface area there.
